title: Rate of flow controls.
officialText:
Grease interceptors shall be equipped with devices to control the rate of water flow so that the
water flow does not exceed the rated flow. The flow-control device shall be vented and terminate not less than 6 inches (152
mm) above the flood rim level or be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
